```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

import csv
import json
import math
import os
import time
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from collections import defaultdict

import plotly.graph_objects as go

CITIES_CACHE = "cities.csv"
NOMINATIM_URL = "https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search"
USER_AGENT = "roots-research-group.github.io (https://github.com/roots-research-group/roots-research-group.github.io)"


def load_city_cache(path):
    cache = {}
    if os.path.exists(path):
        with open(path, newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            for row in csv.DictReader(f):
                cache[(row["City"], row["Country"])] = (float(row["Latitude"]), float(row["Longitude"]))
    return cache


def save_city_cache(path, cache):
    with open(path, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        writer = csv.writer(f)
        writer.writerow(["City", "Country", "Latitude", "Longitude"])
        for (city, country), (lat, lon) in sorted(cache.items()):
            writer.writerow([city, country, lat, lon])


def geocode(city, country):
    params = urllib.parse.urlencode({"q": f"{city}, {country}", "format": "json", "limit": 1})
    req = urllib.request.Request(f"{NOMINATIM_URL}?{params}", headers={"User-Agent": USER_AGENT})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=10) as resp:
        results = json.load(resp)
    if not results:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not geocode '{city}, {country}' via Nominatim")
    return float(results[0]["lat"]), float(results[0]["lon"])


with open("members.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    members = list(csv.DictReader(f))

# cities.csv is an auto-updated coordinate cache: don't edit it by hand,
# it's regenerated here whenever members.csv contains a city not seen before.
coords = load_city_cache(CITIES_CACHE)
missing = sorted({(row["City"], row["Country"]) for row in members} - coords.keys())
for i, (city, country) in enumerate(missing):
    if i > 0:
        time.sleep(1)  # respect Nominatim's 1 request/second usage policy
    coords[(city, country)] = geocode(city, country)
if missing:
    save_city_cache(CITIES_CACHE, coords)

# aggregate members that share a city so pins don't stack
groups = defaultdict(list)
for row in members:
    groups[(row["City"], row["Country"])].append(row["Name"])

lats, lons, hovers, counts = [], [], [], []
for (city, country), names in sorted(groups.items(), key=lambda x: -len(x[1])):
    lat, lon = coords[(city, country)]
    n = len(names)
    lats.append(lat)
    lons.append(lon)
    counts.append(n)
    names_html = "<br>".join(f"&#8226; {nm}" for nm in sorted(names))
    hovers.append(f"<b>{city}, {country}</b><br>{n} member{'s' if n != 1 else ''}<br>{names_html}")

# area-proportional marker size
marker_sizes = [10 + 9 * math.sqrt(c) for c in counts]

fig = go.Figure(
    go.Scattermap(
        lat=lats,
        lon=lons,
        mode="markers",
        marker=dict(size=marker_sizes, color="#3A6EA5", opacity=0.88),
        text=hovers,
        hoverinfo="text",
        hovertemplate="%{text}<extra></extra>",
    )
)

fig.update_layout(
    map=dict(style="carto-positron", center=dict(lat=48.5, lon=8), zoom=2.85),
    margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=0, b=0),
    height=560,
    hoverlabel=dict(bgcolor="#1F2933", font=dict(color="#F4F6F8", size=12), align="left"),
    showlegend=False,
)

fig
```


```{python}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false

import csv
import plotly.graph_objects as go

with open("members.csv", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    rows = list(csv.DictReader(f))

names = [r["Name"] for r in rows]
institutions = [r["Institution"] for r in rows]
cities = [r["City"] for r in rows]
countries = [r["Country"] for r in rows]
profiles = [f'<a href="{r["Profile"]}">Profile</a>' if r["Profile"] else "" for r in rows]

n = len(rows)
row_colors = ["#FFFFFF" if i % 2 == 0 else "#F4F1E9" for i in range(n)]
header_height = 34
row_height = 28

fig = go.Figure(
    go.Table(
        columnwidth=[170, 230, 110, 130, 70],
        header=dict(
            values=["<b>Name</b>", "<b>Institution</b>", "<b>City</b>", "<b>Country</b>", "<b>Profile</b>"],
            fill_color="#3A6EA5",
            font=dict(color="white", size=13, family="IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif"),
            align="left",
            height=header_height,
        ),
        cells=dict(
            values=[names, institutions, cities, countries, profiles],
            fill_color=[row_colors] * 5,
            font=dict(color="#26221B", size=12, family="IBM Plex Sans, sans-serif"),
            align="left",
            height=row_height,
        ),
    )
)

fig.update_layout(
    margin=dict(l=0, r=0, t=8, b=8),
    height=header_height + row_height * n + 20,
)

fig
```
